decision: Use public stable releases as the update authority and expose one systemd-user auto-update switch in GNOME and KDE through the installed update.sh owner.
reason: The installed updater falsely reported current from an old development upstream. The user explicitly requested an enabled auto-update menu switch and mandatory installed updater verification before finishing releases. Actual installation also exposed the already-cached pre-1.0.92 GNOME loader omitting the new hint module; stage that missing dependency into its per-enable directory without restarting the desktop.
verification: Executable isolated updater, update-mode installer and frontend adapter tests; actual installed entrypoint, stable public release and enabled timer verification recorded in docs/architecture/stable-auto-update-2026-10-19.md.
not_tested: Historical native input receipts do not certify new input behavior. No input core, delivery route, learning algorithm or model authority is changed.
